rules: Telepathy or empathy never exposes World Truth directly.
Every reading resolves against target, context, species/state limitations and available capability.
Sensing emotion is not equivalent to knowing motive, memory or objective fact.
Ferengi and Changeling limitations remain target/context rules rather than universal binary immunity.
Consent, privacy and professional rules are contextual and remain separate from raw biological capability.
AI receives only the resolved information actually available to the character.
AI cannot invent a successful reading, hidden motive or secret.
